name: Agent Action Format
description: Turns what a model wrote as its actions into effects in a folder. The words of an action are a format, and a model does best in the format it was trained on: a provider's native tool calls, an edit format per model family, or a private text protocol. A harness that drives several model families reads each in its own format instead of choosing one by habit.
purpose: Execute a model's actions in the format that model is trained on, so no call is spent on a protocol it must be taught.
approach: Read a reply as the format its model family emits, run each action inside the folder it was given, and return one outcome per action in the order they were written.
out_of_scope: Choosing which model or which loop drives the work (Delegated Agent Sessions does that), running a command safely (Command Execution does that) and editing a single file by instruction (File Editing does that).
milestones: 1. Every scripted reply is executed with its intended effect in each format a model of a supported family emits (authoritative metric metric-agent-action-format).
knowledge: Anthropic documents its bash and text editor tools as client tools whose schema is built into the model, and says models tend to perform better with formats that match their training data (2025-09-11). Aider's own benchmark moved GPT-4 Turbo from 20 to 61 percent by changing only the edit format. A real lane run of the hub loop failed four times in part because the model wrote function-call markup instead of the text protocol, which the parser then ignored. OpenAI apply_patch (V4A) and Gemini CLI tools are researched and not built (registry area agent_action_format).
measures_of_success: Every scripted reply, in every format, leaves the effect it states.
inputs: A model reply and a working folder.
outputs: One outcome per action: its kind, whether it succeeded and its text.
effects: Runs the actions in the working folder; a path outside it is refused.
usage_notes: Call hubofhubs.run("agent-action-format", {"reply": ..., "working_dir": ...}). A paid stage (tasks completed per arm on the same model) is the metric of Delegated Agent Sessions; the native loop of a provider's own agent executes its own calls and cannot be scripted offline.
